newsitem.title: UK: Petrofina says 1996 Euro refining margins up 47 ct.
newsitem.headline: Petrofina says 1996 Euro refining margins up 47 ct.

text.p: Belgian oil company Petrofina said European refining profit margins last year rose by 47 cents a barrel.
Presenting final annual results on Wednesday, the company said refining margins, before fixed costs, rose to $2.27 a barrel from $1.80 in 1995.
The company operates a refinery in Antwerp and has a share in Britain's Killingholme plant.
It said its deep conversion unit at Antwerp made a strong contribution to improved refinery returns in the second half of last year.
Refining margins across Europe sank to 10-year lows in 1995 sparking a rash of refinery closures and mergers last year.
